title: Functional universality of critical SK autocorrelations

abstractEnglish: We prove that the stationary spin autocorrelation of the zero-field Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model at inverse temperature β = 1 has a common functional scaling limit for Gaussian and Rademacher couplings. With rate-one heat-bath clocks at every site, time is scaled by n2/3 and the mean spin autocorrelation is multiplied by n1/3. The functions converge in law uniformly on compact positive-time intervals. Their limiting law is not a point mass: it retains sample-to-sample randomness, and its functions decay to zero at large times.

details.overview: 稿件研究零场Sherrington–Kirkpatrick模型在逆温度β=1时的平稳自旋自相关。摘要表示，作者证明对高斯耦合与Rademacher耦合，该自相关具有共同的泛函标度极限：每个格点配速率一的热浴时钟，时间按n^{2/3}缩放，平均自旋自相关乘以n^{1/3}，函数在紧正时间区间上依分布一致收敛。作者声称极限律不是点质量，保留样本间随机性，且函数在大时间趋于零。该结果属于平均场自旋玻璃动力学研究；摘要未给出证明细节。
keyPoints: 研究对象为β=1时SK模型的平稳自旋自相关。
作者声称高斯与Rademacher耦合具有共同泛函标度极限。
极限律保留样本随机性，且函数在大时间衰减到零。
